policy.runtime_merge: Overlay these fields on data/patterns.json by matching pattern_id.

definition.ja: 2色の糸で作るブロークンツイル系のチェックで、先の尖った四方向の形が連続して見える柄です。
definition.en: A two-color broken-twill check whose repeat forms jagged, four-pointed shapes.

ja: 尖った四方向の形が規則的に反復する
通常の格子より輪郭が崩れ、歯や鳥のシルエットのように見える
色よりもギザギザした反復構造で識別する
en: Look for jagged four-pointed units in a regular repeat
The check is visually broken rather than made of plain square cells
Identify it by the pointed repeat, not by a specific colorway

colors.primary_reason: High-contrast editorial recognition reference; black and white are not the only valid colors.

patterns.term_scope: checked cloth / regular two-color check appearance

definition.ja: 白地と有色糸の縦横の帯が同じリズムで交差し、明暗の四角が規則的に並ぶチェックです。
definition.en: A regular check created by crossing colored and white bands, producing repeated light, medium, and darker squares.

ja: 縦横の帯幅が揃い、規則的な四角が並ぶ
交差部が濃く見え、中間色と白地が繰り返される
複雑な太細線よりも均等な反復が目印
en: Equal-width horizontal and vertical bands form regular squares
Intersections read darker than the single-color bands
The even rhythm distinguishes it from more complex plaids

colors.primary_reason: Editorial recognition reference; white plus a colored check is characteristic, but blue is not required.

definition.ja: 複数色の縦横のストライプを一定の順序と幅で反復し、格子状の「sett」を作る織柄です。
definition.en: A woven design in which colored stripes repeat vertically and horizontally in a defined sequence and proportion to form a sett.

ja: 縦と横で同じ色列が交差する
線の色順と幅の比率が個々のタータン識別に関わる
単なる多色チェックよりsettの反復を重視する
en: The same stripe sequence crosses in warp and weft
Color order and stripe proportions matter to a specific tartan sett
The repeated sett distinguishes tartan from a generic multicolor plaid

colors.primary_reason: For a specific tartan, color sequence and stripe proportions are part of its sett; this palette is only an editorial reference.

ja: グレナカートチェック

definition.ja: 細かなチェックやブロークンチェックを組み合わせ、さらに大きな格子として見える複合チェックです。
definition.en: A compound check combining small checks and broken checks so that a larger-scale plaid emerges.

ja: 小さな格子の集合がさらに大きな格子を作る
遠目では灰色調や細かな織柄に見えやすい
単純な千鳥格子より複数スケールの格子がある
en: Small checks combine into a larger-scale check
It often reads as a fine gray or muted texture from a distance
Multiple check scales distinguish it from plain houndstooth

colors.primary_reason: Muted gray/black/white is a useful recognition reference, not a defining rule.

patterns.term_scope: diamond-pattern family used especially in knitwear

definition.ja: 色の異なる菱形を反復し、細い斜線が菱形の上を交差する構成が多い幾何学柄です。
definition.en: A repeating diamond pattern, commonly with thin diagonal lines crossing over the colored lozenges.

ja: 細い対角線が菱形を横切る構成が典型的
単なるダイヤ柄より線の重なりが識別の手掛かり
en: Repeating diamonds or lozenges form the base
Thin diagonal lines commonly cross the diamonds
The overlaid diagonal network helps distinguish argyle from a plain diamond repeat

colors.primary_reason: Argyle uses many palettes; this is only a stable editorial reference.

definition.ja: V字または山形の帯を連続させ、規則的なジグザグを作る幾何学模様です。
definition.en: A geometric repeat built from V-shaped units or bands that create a regular zigzag.

ja: V字が同じ向きと間隔で連続する
山と谷が明瞭なジグザグ線になる
ヘリンボーンのような短い斜線の組み合わせではなく、連続Vを優先して見る
en: Repeated V-shaped units form clear peaks and valleys
The zigzag is continuous and regular
Unlike herringbone, the primary cue is a continuous V rhythm rather than offset short strokes

colors.primary_reason: Geometry rather than color defines the motif.

definition.ja: 同程度の大きさの丸い点を一定の間隔で反復する水玉模様です。
definition.en: A surface pattern of regularly repeated round dots, usually consistent in size and spacing.

ja: 丸い点が多数反復する
点の大きさと間隔に規則性がある
不規則な斑点や動物柄ではなく、人工的な配置が目印
en: Many round dots repeat across the surface
Dot size and spacing are usually regular
The ordered placement distinguishes it from irregular spots or animal markings

colors.primary_reason: Round repeated dots define the pattern; color is variable.

definition.ja: 丸みのある辺と上下の尖りをもつ格子セルなどを反復する、現代のインテリア市場で「Moroccan Trellis」と呼ばれる装飾柄の総称的ラベルです。
definition.en: A contemporary decorative-market label for repeating lattice cells, often with rounded sides and pointed top and bottom.

ja: 同形の格子セルが連続して面を埋める
セルはランタン形・四つ葉形に近い変種を含む
歴史的に単一のモロッコ正典文様と断定せず、市場ラベルとして扱う
en: Repeating lattice cells fill the surface
Common variants resemble lantern or quatrefoil-like cells
Treat the term as a contemporary market label, not as one uniquely canonical historic Moroccan motif

qualification.ja: この名称は現代のインテリア／柄市場で広く使われるラベルとして扱い、単一の歴史的モロッコ正典文様だとは断定しません。
qualification.en: This entry treats the name as a contemporary interiors/pattern-market label and does not claim one uniquely canonical historic Moroccan motif.

colors.primary_reason: No defining historic palette is asserted; this is an editorial reference.

definition.ja: 同心円状の半円弧を扇形に重ね、波が連なって見える日本の伝統文様です。
definition.en: A Japanese traditional motif made from overlapping concentric semicircular arcs arranged like repeating waves.

ja: 半円の中に複数の同心弧がある
半円同士が段違いに重なり波の列を作る
単なる鱗形や円弧ではなく扇状の波の反復が目印
en: Each fan contains several concentric arcs
The fans overlap in staggered rows to read as waves
The layered wave-fan repeat distinguishes it from simple scallops

colors.primary_reason: Indigo/white is an editorial traditional reference; the motif itself is structural.

definition.ja: 正六角形を基礎に放射状の線を組み、麻の葉を思わせる星形が連続する日本の幾何学文様です。
definition.en: A Japanese geometric motif built from regular hexagons and radiating lines, forming star-like units associated with hemp leaves.

ja: 六角形を基礎に細線が中心から放射する
六方向の星形・葉形が連続する
亀甲より内部線が多く、星状の細かな分割が目立つ
en: Regular hexagons provide the underlying grid
Radiating lines create six-point star or leaf-like units
More internal spokes than kikko make the star-like subdivision prominent

ja: 木工・組子風デザイン

colors.primary_reason: Indigo/white is an editorial traditional reference; color does not define the motif.

definition.ja: 同じ大きさの円弧を四分の一ずつ重ね、連続した円形・花形を作る日本の伝統文様です。
definition.en: A Japanese traditional motif formed by overlapping equal circular arcs to create a continuous network of circles and petal-like intersections.

ja: 同じ半径の円が規則的に重なる
交差部に四弁の花のような形が現れる
青海波より完全な円のネットワークとして見える
en: Equal-radius circles overlap in a regular network
It reads as interlocking circles rather than the fan-shaped wave units of seigaiha

colors.primary_reason: Indigo/white is an editorial traditional reference; the circle geometry is defining.

definition.ja: 対照的な色や明度の正方形を交互に並べる、日本で「市松」と呼ばれる格子文様です。
definition.en: The Japanese term for a checker arrangement of alternating square cells in contrasting colors or values.

ja: 同じ大きさの正方形が縦横に並ぶ
隣り合うマスが交互に色・明度を変える
色自体は固定されず、交互配列が本体
en: Equal-size square cells form a grid
Adjacent cells alternate in color or value
The alternating arrangement defines the motif; the colors are not fixed

colors.primary_reason: Black/white is an editorial reference; the alternating-square arrangement is defining.

definition.ja: 正六角形を連続させ、亀の甲羅を思わせる日本の伝統的な幾何学文様です。
definition.en: A Japanese traditional geometric motif based on repeating hexagons associated with tortoiseshell.

ja: 六角形が隙間なく連続する
基本形は内部の放射線を必要としない
麻の葉より単純な六角セルの輪郭が主役
en: Hexagons repeat in a close tessellation
The basic form does not require the internal spokes seen in asanoha
The hexagonal cell outline is the primary cue

colors.primary_reason: Indigo/white is an editorial traditional reference; the hexagonal geometry is defining.

definition.ja: 茎やつるが曲線で連続し、葉や枝を伸ばしながら反復する日本の唐草文様です。
definition.en: A Japanese scrolling-vine motif in which stems and tendrils continue in flowing curves with leaves or offshoots.

ja: 途切れにくい蔓状の曲線が連続する
葉や枝が主線から伸びる
ペイズリーの独立した滴形より、つながる蔓の流れを重視する
en: Continuous vine-like curves travel across the surface
Leaves or branches grow from the main scroll
The connected vine flow distinguishes it from separate paisley boteh units

colors.primary_reason: Green/cream is an editorial traditional reference; the scrolling vine structure is defining.

patterns.term_scope: reversible figured weave / damask-derived ornamental surface pattern

definition.ja: 本来は表裏で地と文様の光沢関係が反転する織物・織組織を指し、現代の表面デザインでは大きな植物・花文様の反復を「ダマスク柄」と呼ぶことがあります。
definition.en: Originally a figured, often reversible weave in which pattern and ground contrast through weave structure; in modern surface design, 'damask pattern' often refers to large repeating floral or foliate motifs derived from that look.

ja: 大きな植物・花・葉のモチーフが反復する表面柄が多い
左右対称に見える構成は一般的だが絶対条件ではない
歴史的な定義はモチーフ形より織組織にある
en: Modern surface versions often repeat large floral or foliate motifs
Symmetry is common but not an absolute defining rule
Historically, damask is defined by weave structure rather than one fixed motif shape

colors.primary_reason: The weave or ornamental structure is defining, not a fixed palette.

patterns.term_scope: scrolling vegetal and geometric ornamental tradition

definition.ja: 植物の茎・葉を抽象化した連続曲線や幾何学的反復を組み合わせる装飾様式・文様群です。
definition.en: An ornamental tradition using rhythmic scrolling vegetal forms, geometric repetition, or combinations of the two.

ja: 曲線的なつる・葉が反復しながら連続する
幾何学的な反復と組み合わさる場合がある
単一の固定モチーフ名ではなく装飾様式の広いカテゴリー
en: Geometric repetition may be combined with foliage
It is a broad ornamental category rather than one single fixed motif

colors.primary_reason: The ornamental structure is defining, not a fixed palette.

definition.ja: 先端が曲がった滴形・葉形の「boteh」を主要モチーフとして反復する装飾柄です。
definition.en: An ornamental repeat built around the boteh, a curved teardrop- or leaf-like motif.

ja: 先端が一方向へ曲がる滴形・葉形が中心
内部に細かな植物・幾何学装飾を持つことが多い
唐草のような連続蔓ではなく、独立したboteh単位が見分けやすい
en: Curved teardrop or leaf-shaped boteh units are the main cue
The motifs often contain smaller floral or geometric decoration
Separate boteh units distinguish paisley from a continuous vine scroll

colors.primary_reason: Boteh structure defines the pattern; no single palette is required.

patterns.term_scope: animal-print imitation of leopard coat markings

definition.ja: ヒョウの被毛に見られる斑紋を模したアニマルプリントで、輪状・ロゼット状の斑点と不規則な点が組み合わさります。
definition.en: An animal print imitating leopard coat markings, using irregular spots and rosette-like ringed markings.

ja: 斑点の位置と大きさが規則正しく揃わない
単純な黒点だけでなく輪状・ロゼット状の斑が混じる
水玉のような等間隔の反復ではない
en: Spot size and placement are irregular
Ringed or rosette-like marks mix with solid spots
It lacks the even spacing and uniform dots of polka dot

colors.primary_reason: Natural leopard coloration supports recognition, though fashion prints may recolor it.

patterns.term_scope: resist-dyeing technique applied to yarn before weaving

definition.ja: 織る前の経糸・緯糸または両方を部分的に防染してから織る技法で、その工程に由来する輪郭のにじみ・ずれがイカットらしい表情を作ります。
definition.en: A resist-dyeing technique in which warp, weft, or both are bound and dyed before weaving; the process often produces softly feathered or shifted motif edges.

ja: モチーフの輪郭にわずかなずれやぼかしが見える
幾何学形や植物形など多様で、形そのものは固定されない
単一の柄名ではなく制作技法として扱う
en: Motif edges often look softly feathered or slightly misregistered
Geometric and floral motifs vary widely; no single shape defines ikat
Treat ikat primarily as a textile technique rather than one fixed pattern

ja: インテリアテキスタイル

qualification.ja: イカットは単一の固定柄ではなく、糸を先に防染してから織る技法です。本辞典では、その技法から生じる視覚的特徴を検索対象にします。
qualification.en: Ikat is not one fixed motif; it is a yarn-resist dyeing technique. This dictionary indexes the visual characteristics produced by that technique.

colors.primary_reason: Indigo/white is an editorial recognition reference; technique, not palette, defines ikat.

patterns.term_scope: flat-woven textile category and kilim-inspired visual family, not one fixed motif

definition.ja: キリムは毛足のない平織り系の敷物・織物カテゴリーで、表面には菱形、フック、帯状幾何学など多様なモチーフが用いられます。本辞典では市場でいう「キリム柄」を、その外観を指す検索ラベルとして扱います。
definition.en: Kilim is a category of pileless flat-woven rugs and textiles that can carry many geometric motifs. Here, 'kilim pattern' is treated as a search label for that visual family rather than one single canonical motif.

ja: 平面的な織物上に幾何学モチーフが反復することが多い
菱形・フック・帯など複数のモチーフ体系を含む
一つの固定柄ではなくキリム外観の検索カテゴリーとして扱う
en: Flat-woven surfaces often carry repeated geometric motifs
Diamonds, hooks, bands, and other motifs vary across kilims
Treat it as a visual search family, not as one fixed canonical pattern

qualification.ja: キリムは単一の固定模様名ではなく、平織り系の敷物・織物カテゴリーです。「キリム柄」はその外観を探すための検索ラベルとして扱います。
qualification.en: Kilim is not one fixed pattern name; it is a category of flat-woven rugs/textiles. 'Kilim pattern' is used here as a practical visual-search label.

colors.primary_reason: Kilim traditions use diverse colors and designs; this fixed palette is only an editorial recognition reference.

names.ja: バッファローチェック

ja: バッファローチェック柄

definition.ja: 大きく均等な二色の格子を反復するチェック柄です。赤と黒の組み合わせが代表的ですが、識別の中心は大きな等間隔の格子です。
definition.en: A large, evenly spaced two-color check. Red and black are the best-known combination, but the key cue is the bold regular grid.

ja: ギンガムより大きな格子として見えることが多い
縦横の帯幅がそろった単純な二色格子
赤黒は代表的だが必須条件ではない
en: Usually reads at a larger scale than gingham
Uses a simple regular grid of equal-width crossing bands
Red and black are conventional rather than mandatory

colors.primary_reason: Red-and-black is the historically documented and dominant recognition convention, while the geometry remains the key structural cue.

ja: シェパードチェック柄

definition.ja: 細かな二色の線を等間隔で交差させ、小さく均一な格子を作るチェック柄です。黒白が古典的な認識例です。
definition.en: A small, even check formed by crossing contrasting stripes at regular intervals, classically in black and white.

ja: 小さく均一な格子が連続する
千鳥格子のような尖った崩れがない
ガンクラブチェックより配色と構造が単純
en: Lacks the jagged tooth-like breakup of houndstooth
Is simpler in color and layering than gun-club checks

colors.primary_reason: Black-and-white is explicitly documented as a classic construction, but the pattern family is not restricted to one palette.

names.ja: ウィンドウペーンチェック

definition.ja: 細い縦線と横線を広い間隔で交差させ、窓枠のような大きな四角を作るチェック柄です。
definition.en: A large-scale check made from thin horizontal and vertical lines spaced widely apart, resembling window panes.

ja: 線が細く、格子の空白が大きい
タッターソールより色数が少なく単純に見えやすい
グレンチェックの細かな複合格子とはスケールが異なる
en: Uses thin lines around large open cells
Usually reads more simply than multicolor Tattersall
Operates at a much larger scale than the fine compound base of Glen Check

colors.primary_reason: The pane-like grid and large scale define the recognition target, not a fixed color.

patterns.term_scope: Madras textile/check style rather than one fixed grid specification

definition.ja: マドラス／チェンナイの綿織物文化と結びつく、多色の縦横線が交差するチェック系の見た目です。ひとつの固定格子を指す語ではありません。
definition.en: A multicolor woven check/plaid appearance associated with Madras/Chennai cotton textiles. It is a textile tradition and style, not one immutable grid.

ja: 複数色の帯が縦横に交差する
明るい多色使いが現代の強い認識手掛かり
特定の一種類の格子だけを正解としない
en: Uses crossing bands in multiple colors
Bright multicolor combinations are a strong modern cue
Should not be reduced to one supposedly authentic repeat

colors.primary_reason: Multicolor plaid is a strong modern recognition cue, but sources do not support one exclusive palette.

qualification.ja: マドラス／チェンナイの綿織物文化と結びつく、多色の縦横線が交差するチェック系の見た目です。ひとつの固定格子を指す語ではありません。
qualification.en: Madras is also a cloth/textile term and historical textile tradition, not a single immutable check geometry. Detail copy must not present one reference repeat as the only authentic Madras pattern.

ja: タッターソールチェック
タッタソールチェック

patterns.term_scope: thin-line multicolor check on a light ground

definition.ja: 明るい地色の上に、複数色の細い線を縦横に交差させて四角を作るチェック柄です。
definition.en: A check of thin colored crossbars forming repeated squares on a usually light ground, often using more than one stripe color.

ja: 地色が広く見える細線中心の格子
二色以上の細い線を使うことが多い
ウィンドウペーンより線と色の組み合わせが細かい
en: Leaves substantial light ground visible between thin lines
Often combines two or more stripe colors
Is usually finer and more multicolor than Windowpane

colors.primary_reason: Light ground plus multiple thin colored lines is a stronger recognition cue than any one palette.

ja: ガンクラブチェック柄

patterns.term_scope: multicolor district-check family derived from shepherd-check variation

definition.ja: シェパードチェック系の細かな格子を基礎に、複数の色調や格子層を組み合わせるチェック柄です。
definition.en: A multitone district-check family built from a small shepherd-check-like base with added colors or check layers.

ja: 小格子を基礎に複数色が見える
シェパードチェックより色調と層が複雑
遠目では細かな混色の格子として見える
en: Starts from a small-check base and introduces multiple tones
Is more layered and colorful than Shepherd's Check
Can read as a fine blended check from a distance

colors.primary_reason: Multiple contrasting tones are characteristic, but exact colors vary across gun-club checks.

names.ja: プリンス・オブ・ウェールズ・チェック

ja: プリンスオブウェールズチェック

patterns.term_scope: glen-check-derived check convention with modern naming overlap

definition.ja: グレンチェック系の細かな複合格子に、より大きな対比色のオーバーチェックを重ねる形で説明されることが多いチェックです。現代ではグレンチェックと同義的に使われる場合もあります。
definition.en: A Glen-Check-like compound check commonly distinguished by a larger contrasting overcheck, although modern usage often overlaps with the term Glen Check.

ja: 細かなグレン系格子の上に大きな線格子が見える
実用上はオーバーチェックの有無が重要な手掛かり
名称はグレンチェックと重なって使われることがある
en: Shows a fine Glen-like base plus a larger overcheck
The overcheck is the most useful practical cue
Naming can overlap with Glen Check in modern usage

colors.primary_reason: Neutral glen-like base plus a contrasting overcheck is a useful recognition reference, not a universal color rule.

qualification.ja: グレンチェック系の細かな複合格子に、より大きな対比色のオーバーチェックを重ねる形で説明されることが多いチェックです。現代ではグレンチェックと同義的に使われる場合もあります。
qualification.en: Modern sources often use Prince of Wales Check and Glen Check interchangeably, while historical and tailoring references distinguish Prince of Wales through an added overcheck or specific lineage. Detail copy must state both the practical distinction and the naming overlap.

patterns.term_scope: very narrow parallel stripe pattern in cloth

definition.ja: 暗い地の上に、ごく細い淡色の平行線を一定間隔で並べるストライプです。
definition.en: A stripe pattern of very narrow, usually pale parallel lines set at regular intervals on darker cloth.

ja: 線同士の間隔が広く地色が大きく見える
チョークストライプより細く輪郭がシャープ
en: Leaves substantial ground visible between stripes
Is finer and sharper than Chalk Stripe

colors.primary_reason: Pale narrow lines on a dark ground are well documented, but exact colors are variable.

ja: チョークストライプ柄

patterns.term_scope: wider softer parallel stripe convention used in suiting

definition.ja: 暗い地に淡い平行線を並べるストライプで、ピンストライプより線が太く、チョークで引いたように柔らかく見えるのが特徴です。
definition.en: A pale-on-dark parallel stripe that is wider and usually softer or more muted in appearance than a pinstripe.

ja: ピンストライプより線幅が太い
線の輪郭がやや柔らかく見える
暗色地に淡色線のスーツ地でよく見られる
en: The stripe edge often reads softer or chalkier
Commonly appears as pale lines on dark suiting

colors.primary_reason: White/pale lines on dark cloth are conventional; width/softness relative to pinstripe is the stronger distinction.

ja: ベンガルストライプ柄

definition.ja: 色帯と白帯をほぼ同じ幅で交互に並べる、均等で明快なストライプです。
definition.en: A balanced stripe of alternating colored and white bands, generally broader than fine pin or pencil stripes.

ja: 色帯と白帯の幅が近い
細いピンストライプより面として見える
シャツ地でよく使われる明快な反復
en: Colored and white bands are close in width
Reads as alternating bands rather than hairline marks

colors.primary_reason: Alternating white and color is structural; blue is only a familiar recognition reference.

definition.ja: 縦線と横線を交差させて四角・長方形の区画を作る、日本の広い格子文様群です。線幅や本数、間隔によって多くの派生があります。
definition.en: A broad Japanese lattice/check family formed by intersecting vertical and horizontal lines, with many variants in spacing, line weight, and count.

ja: 線そのものが交差して格子を作る
市松のように塗りつぶした正方形を交互に置く構造とは異なる
ひとつの固定反復ではなく多数の格子系を含む
en: The lattice is constructed from crossing lines
It differs from Ichimatsu's alternating filled squares
It is a family of lattice variants rather than one fixed repeat

colors.primary_reason: Line intersection defines the family; color is not intrinsic.

qualification.ja: 縦線と横線を交差させて四角・長方形の区画を作る、日本の広い格子文様群です。線幅や本数、間隔によって多くの派生があります。
qualification.en: Koushi/格子 is a broad Japanese pattern family with many variants, not one unique repeat. Detail copy must distinguish this line-based lattice family from Ichimatsu's alternating filled squares.

names.ja: オーニングストライプ

ja: オーニングストライプ柄

patterns.term_scope: very broad stripe convention named after awnings

definition.ja: 店舗や屋外の日よけを思わせる、太く大胆な帯を規則的に反復するストライプです。
definition.en: A bold, broad, regularly repeated stripe named for the large-scale bands seen on traditional awnings.

ja: 帯幅が大きく遠目でも強く見える
ベンガルストライプより大判に見えやすい
色よりも太い規則反復が識別の中心
en: Uses broad bands that remain obvious at a distance
Usually reads larger in scale than Bengal Stripe
The bold regular banding matters more than a specific color

colors.primary_reason: Large stripe scale is defining; exact color is variable.

names.ja: レジメンタルストライプ

patterns.term_scope: stripe style associated with English/British regimental ties rather than one fixed repeat

definition.ja: 英国の連隊ネクタイなどと結びつく斜め縞のスタイル群です。特定の一色順・線幅・方向だけをレジメンタルの正解とはできません。
definition.en: A family of diagonal stripe conventions associated with British regimental neckwear. No single color sequence, width, or direction defines the whole category.

ja: ネクタイで見られる斜めの反復縞が代表的
色の組み合わせが所属や伝統と結びつく場合がある
一般化した参考柄を特定連隊の真正柄とは扱わない
en: Diagonal repeated bands are the common neckwear cue
Color combinations may carry organizational meaning
A generic reference must not be presented as an authentic design for a specific regiment

colors.primary_reason: Specific color sequences may carry organizational meaning, so the reference palette must not be presented as universal.

qualification.ja: 英国の連隊ネクタイなどと結びつく斜め縞のスタイル群です。特定の一色順・線幅・方向だけをレジメンタルの正解とはできません。
qualification.en: Regimental Stripe is a style/family label tied to regimental neckwear conventions, not one universal color sequence, stripe width, or direction. The dictionary must avoid assigning one generic stripe as an authentic regiment-specific design.

patterns.term_scope: French maritime clothing/style convention derived from striped naval knitwear

definition.ja: フランスの海軍・海洋服の歴史と結びつく、青や紺と白の横縞を代表例とするスタイルです。現代のブレトン柄は歴史的制服仕様より広い概念です。
definition.en: A maritime clothing convention associated with the French naval/Breton-top tradition, classically using blue or navy horizontal stripes on white. Modern usage is broader than the historic uniform specification.

ja: 横方向の青・紺と白の縞が強い認識手掛かり
衣服、とくにボートネック系トップスとの結びつきが強い
現代品の線幅や本数は歴史的制服仕様に限定されない
en: Blue/navy horizontal stripes on white are the strongest cue
Modern stripe count and spacing need not match the historic naval uniform

colors.primary_reason: Blue-and-white horizontal striping is central to the historic naval reference, while modern Breton-style garments vary spacing and colors.

qualification.ja: フランスの海軍・海洋服の歴史と結びつく、青や紺と白の横縞を代表例とするスタイルです。現代のブレトン柄は歴史的制服仕様より広い概念です。
qualification.en: The historic French naval garment had specific uniform dimensions, but modern 'Breton stripe' is a broader fashion convention. Detail copy must distinguish the historical marinière specification from contemporary Breton-style stripes.

patterns.term_scope: dotted Swiss textile/fabric category, not generic printed polka dots

definition.ja: 薄く張りのある生地の表面に小さな点を持つドッテッドスイス系の生地表現です。単なる平面印刷の水玉とは区別します。
definition.en: A dotted-Swiss textile appearance: fine, sheer, crisp fabric carrying small surface dots. It is a fabric/treatment category, not simply flat printed polka dots.

ja: 小さな点が生地表面の織り・刺繍・フロックなどとして見える
水玉より点が小さく繊細なことが多い
点そのものだけでなく薄地の質感が識別に重要
en: Dots appear as a surface treatment such as woven, embroidered, or flocked detail
The dots are often smaller and subtler than ordinary polka dots
Sheer crisp textile character is part of the recognition cue

colors.primary_reason: Texture and dotted surface treatment matter more than color; white-on-white is a neutral recognition reference.

qualification.ja: 薄く張りのある生地の表面に小さな点を持つドッテッドスイス系の生地表現です。単なる平面印刷の水玉とは区別します。
qualification.en: Swiss Dot/Dotted Swiss fundamentally names a dotted fabric/textile treatment. The dictionary must not collapse it into ordinary flat printed polka dots, and the reference image should convey textile surface/relief.

patterns.term_scope: herringbone weave/arrangement and its broken-V visual family

definition.ja: 短い斜線の列が途中で向きを反転し、折れたV字や魚の骨のような連続列を作る構造です。織りとしても広い視覚配置としても使われます。
definition.en: An arrangement in which rows of short diagonal strokes reverse direction to form repeated broken V shapes, widely used as a weave and broader visual construction.

ja: V字の頂点で斜線が切り替わり、連続線にならない
シェブロンより魚骨状の細かな構造が見える
織物ではツイル方向の反転として現れる
en: Diagonal strokes reverse at the center instead of forming one continuous chevron band
Shows a finer fish-bone structure than simple Chevron
In cloth it commonly appears through reversing twill direction

colors.primary_reason: Direction reversal and broken-V structure define recognition; color is variable.

qualification.ja: 短い斜線の列が途中で向きを反転し、折れたV字や魚の骨のような連続列を作る構造です。織りとしても広い視覚配置としても使われます。
qualification.en: Herringbone can denote a textile weave, a broader visual arrangement, embroidery, brickwork, and other constructions. In Pattern Dictionary it is represented as the visual family while clearly distinguishing the common woven form from a simple printed Chevron/Zigzag.

definition.ja: 直線が鋭い角度で交互に方向を変え、Z字が連なるように見える広い幾何学パターンです。
definition.en: A broad geometric pattern in which a line repeatedly changes direction at sharp angles, resembling a row of joined Z shapes.

ja: 鋭角で左右へ折れ返す線が主役
V字単位を帯として反復するシェブロンより広い概念
ヘリンボーンのような短い斜線列の反転を必要としない
en: Defined by repeated sharp directional changes
Broader than Chevron, which emphasizes repeated V-shaped bands
Does not require Herringbone's rows of short reversing strokes

colors.primary_reason: Angular path geometry, not color, defines the generic family.

definition.ja: 菱形・ダイヤ形を規則的に反復する広い幾何学パターンです。色や内部の線構造は定義条件ではありません。
definition.en: A broad geometric family built from repeated diamond or rhombus shapes; color and internal line systems are not required parts of the definition.

ja: 菱形そのものの反復が中心
アーガイルのような重なる斜線格子を必要としない
ハーレクインのような塗り分けた衣装的ダイヤ群より広い概念
en: The repeated rhombus itself is the core cue
Does not require Argyle's superimposed diagonal lattice
Is broader than Harlequin's contrasting costume-like diamond blocks

colors.primary_reason: The repeated rhombus geometry defines the family.

patterns.term_scope: diamond-block pattern convention associated with Harlequin costume

definition.ja: ハーレクインの衣装と結びつく、対比色のダイヤ形ブロックを反復する柄です。
definition.en: A repeated field of contrasting diamond-shaped blocks associated with the diamond-patterned costume tradition of Harlequin.

ja: 塗り分けられたダイヤ形ブロックが主役
一般的なダイヤ柄より強い配色対比を伴うことが多い
アーガイルのような細い斜線格子を重ねない
en: Usually relies more heavily on color contrast than a generic diamond repeat
Does not require Argyle's thin overlaid diagonal lattice

colors.primary_reason: Contrasting diamond blocks are characteristic; no single modern palette is universal.

definition.ja: 濃色と淡色の正方形を交互に並べ、チェッカー盤のような規則格子を作る柄です。
definition.en: A regular grid of alternating dark and light squares, like the board used for checkers or draughts.

ja: 隣り合う正方形が交互に明暗を変える
線だけの格子ではなく面が塗り分けられる
市松と見た目が一致する場合があり、名称は文脈で区別する
en: Adjacent squares alternate in value or color
The cells are filled blocks rather than merely crossing lines
It can be visually identical to Ichimatsu, so naming may depend on cultural/contextual framing

colors.primary_reason: Alternation of contrasting square values is defining, while black/white is only the clearest reference.
